test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: What major requirement has the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) removed for non-bank entities facilitating outward remittance services?

options.text: The requirement to obtain prior RBI approval for tie-up arrangements with banks
The obligation to directly oversee Know Your Customer (KYC) compliance
The mandate to restrict outward remittances to offline modes only
The requirement to secure independent foreign exchange rates

solution:
The correct answer is __**The requirement to obtain prior RBI approval for tie-up arrangements with banks**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** has eased outward remittance norms by removing the prior approval requirement for **non-bank entities**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **RBI** has removed the requirement for **non-bank entities** to obtain specific prior approval before entering into tie-up arrangements with banks for facilitating **outward remittance services**.
 
• This changes the earlier **2016 framework**, which mandated specific **RBI approval** for such tie-ups.
 
• Under the revised operating framework, **Authorised Dealer (AD) Category-I banks** will now be solely responsible for ensuring compliance with **FEMA regulations** and **Know Your Customer (KYC)** requirements.
 
• This eliminates the direct regulatory bottleneck for non-bank entities, making the correct answer the removal of the requirement to obtain prior **RBI approval** for tie-up arrangements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The new framework applies to **non-trade current account transactions** facilitated through a third-party entity in **online mode**.
 
• The **online mode** encompasses websites, online platforms, software applications, and mobile applications.
 
• Customers using these third-party online platforms must be clearly informed about the **foreign exchange rate** quoted by the **AD bank**, its validity period, and the **total estimated transaction cost**.
 
• Platforms must also display the exact **foreign exchange amount** to be credited and the maximum time required for the beneficiary to receive the funds.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The revision aims to simplify the process of cross-border **outward remittances** while maintaining strict regulatory compliance exclusively through **AD banks**.
